
## 侦察

访问首页 `/web-client/ch27/`
- 响应
    ```http

    ```
    ```html
    <div id=app></div>
    <script type=text/javascript src=./static/js/manifest.2ae2e69a05c33dfc65f8.js></script>
    <script type=text/javascript src=./static/js/vendor.458c9f5863b8f28e5570.js></script>
    <script type=text/javascript src=./static/js/app.a92c5074dafac0cb6365.js></script>
    ```
    - 每个 JS 均加载一个 .js.map
        ```js
        //# sourceMappingURL=manifest.2ae2e69a05c33dfc65f8.js.map
        //# sourceMappingURL=vendor.458c9f5863b8f28e5570.js.map
        //# sourceMappingURL=app.a92c5074dafac0cb6365.js.map
        ```
    - 每个 .js.map 均使用 webpack 格式
        ```js
        {"version":3,"sources":["webpack://...
        ```

浏览 .js.map source map 文件
- 将 .js.map 文件放入 `~/maps` 目录中，使用工具还原结构
    ```sh
    ./sourcemapper -dir ~/maps -output ./src
    ```
- 其中 `app.a92c5074dafac0cb6365.js.map` 包含特异信息
    - `/src/components/YouWillNotFindThisRouteBecauseItIsHidden.vue` 完整文件内容：

        ```html
        <template>
            <main>
                <div class="home-page">
                    <div class="block">
                        <h1>This a mandarin duck ! </h1>
                        <p class="intro">It is a mandarin duck !!!!! As you can see, it is much more beautiful than a normal duck.</p>
                        <h2>DO NOT EAT THIS ONE !</h2>
                    </div>
                    <div class="block">
                        <img src="/static/duck-mandarin.png" />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </main>
        </template>

        <script>
            export default {
                name: 'Duck',
                data() {
                    return {
                        // Did you know that comment are readable by the end user ?
                        // Well, this because I build the application with the source maps enabled !!!

                        // So please, disable source map when you build for production

                        // Here is your flag : BecauseSourceMapsAreGreatForDebuggingButNotForProduction

                        'msg': 'Quack quack !! :).'
                    }
                }
            }
        </script>

        <style scoped>

        </style>



        // WEBPACK FOOTER //
        // src/components/YouWillNotFindThisRouteBecauseItIsHidden.vue
        ```
        - 注释包含 flag
    - flag 位于 source map 的 JSON 文件的 `sourcesContent` 字段中，作为明文。于是也可直接搜索 flag 字段或查看
    - 注意：source map 还原工具 `shuji` 将大幅重构代码并移除注释

### router

- `webpack:///src/router/index.js`
    ```js
    import Vue from 'vue'
    import Router from 'vue-router'
    import Home from '@/components/Home'
    import Duck from '@/components/Duck'
    import DuckMandarin from '@/components/DuckMandarin'
    import YouWillNotFindThisRouteBecauseItIsHidden from '@/components/YouWillNotFindThisRouteBecauseItIsHidden'

    Vue.use(Router)

    export default new Router({
        routes: [{
                path: '/',
                name: 'Home',
                component: Home
            }, {
                path: '/duck',
                name: 'Duck',
                component: Duck
            }, {
                path: '/duck-mandarin',
                name: 'DuckMandarin',
                component: DuckMandarin
            } // {
            //   path: '/you-will-not-find-this-route-because-it-is-hidden',
            //   name: 'YouWillNotFindThisRouteBecauseItIsHidden',
            //   component: QuackQuack
            // }
        ]
    })

    // WEBPACK FOOTER //
    ```
